bayts.text: our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions; and through him accept my request with thanks.
And grant me, by the right of Your noble Countenance, happiness and all that I long for from You.
And spare me from seeking what You are not pleased for me to seek, by the sanctity of the Preferred one.
And make these letters above all that any author has traced and that has been preserved.
And bless, O Guide (Al-Hādī), with a blessing and peace, him whom I faced with the pens,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant me today the guidance of the noble, and lead Your good pleasure to me in every aim.
And bless, O One, with peace, him who was sent with the teaching,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And spare me idolatry along with hypocrisy, and grant me truthfulness along with concord.
And by these letters give glad tidings to the Houris (of Paradise) and to others besides them among the people of goodness.
And bless, O Most Generous, with peace, the Prophet who removes reproach,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And turn toward others than me every harm that has headed for me, before it reaches me; and lead the gifts to me.
And bless with peace, O Subtle (Al-Laṭīf), him to whom the clustered fruits draw near (Qurʾān 69:23),
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant me, in You and in him, that for which every illustrious blessed one holily envies me.
And bless, O Subtle, and grant peace upon him whose good pleasure my pen seeks,
our master Muḥammad, without end; and lead to him, in his party, what is desired.
And bless with peace, O You Who drove off toward others than me what did harm, and it was driven off,
the Prophet, the Chosen, Muḥammad, his Family, his Companions and the praisers.
And bear witness for me, forever, that I am well pleased with You and with him; through him accept my aims with thanks.
Lead to me the gifts of the noble in the aim, without harm, nor enemies, nor illness.
And make, by Your noble Countenance, all of me well-pleasing before You, and multiply my little.
And grant me the Qurʾān and the lawful, and all that You have chosen for me, as gain.
And grant me the habits (that lead) to the Gardens, and in the Gardens increase my favours.
And bless with peace, O You Who guard all my being, without need of fortresses,
upon him into whose keeping (lit. pocket) You have made me enter, until the Gardens, abiding in his beneficent rain,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And free me forever from turbidity, and turn toward me the glad tidings of the Decree.
And bless, O Benefiter (An-Nāfiʿ), and grant peace upon him whose precedence is well known,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And lead to me today the stations of the men (of Allah), without wavering; and give glad tidings of me to the descendants.
O You in Whom I have believed, possessed of Islām, bless with peace the Prophet,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant me good pleasure together with writing, O Giver Who has given me His Book.
And write a blessing and a peace, O One, for the Chosen and for whoever, through him, has taken refuge in You,
among his Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome, O You Who establish the states.
And write for me protection from sins, and through the obedient make me free of need of the disobedient.
And grant me firmness and recitation, and spare me the hindrances to sweetness.
And make intimate converse with You, for me, sweeter than any other, O You with Whom is what is sweetest.
O Appreciative, O All-Knowing, O Everlasting, One, O Benefiter: truly You are our Lord, the One.
Bless, grant peace and pour Your blessing perpetually upon the Prophet possessed of distinctions, Aḥmad,
his Family and his Companions; and grant me a joy for which those before me holily envy me,
in You and in him, (making me) grateful and knowing, and abiding, never meeting a wrongdoer.
And grant me the reward and grant me benefit, and bestow on me remembrance and grant me elevation.
And bless, O King (Al-Malik), and grant peace upon the Foremost, the Intercessor, the banner,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And accept with thanks, and teach, make lasting, honour perpetually; and grant Your fragrant breath, and what grieves my heart, extinguish it,
without enemies, nor heartache, nor harm, nor wavering; and make the pearls everlasting for me.
And bless, O Benefiter, and grant peace upon the Prophet whose guidance is well known,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And make my writings benefits in his favour, O You Who placed him above the people of loftiness.
By the sanctity of the Qurʾān, accept from me what I have intended, and guard for me what lies before me.
And bless, O Loving, and grant peace upon him toward whom my pen tends,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant me benefit and grant me affection, and be for me with what greatly gladdens.
And bless, O One, and grant peace upon him who effaced harm and the darknesses,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And bless, O Eternal Refuge (Aṣ-Ṣamad), on my behalf, perpetually, and grant peace upon the Prophet Aḥmad,
his Family and his Companions; and drive out what You do not love for me, that it may go out toward others than me.
And bless, O Subtle, on my behalf, forever, the Prophet and Messenger Aḥmad,
his Family and his Companions; and protect me from harm, and honour me with (fulfilled) wishes.
And bless on my behalf, O Subtle, with peace, him whom the pens gladden on my part,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant me two kindnesses in the two Abodes, and spare me the two disgraces and the two fires.
And bless, O Loving, on my behalf, with peace, the Prophet, the Elect, who spares from reproach,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant me an affection that surpasses every moment, and with You make me beloved of the righteous.
And bless, O One, on my behalf, forever, and grant peace upon him from whom the light appeared,
